title: Undergraduate Advanced Selected Topics in Biology; Tissue Engineering
description:
Restricted to Biological Sciences majors.

Prerequisite: C- or better in BSCI207, BSCI330, and MATH140; and permission of BSCI (email bscique@umd.edu). Credit only granted for: BSCI439E or BIOE411.

A review of the fundamental principles involved in the design of engineered tissues and organs. Both biological and engineering ibndamentals will be considered.

(Sponsoring Dept.: BSCI). Acceptable toward BSCI Area credits of CEBG and PHNB; Enrichment for ECEV and MICB; and the Cell Biology category of GENB.

Only one course of the following can be applied to a BSCI degree: BSCI439E, BSCI439G, BSCI439I, BSCI439J, and BSCI439K.
